AI Model Claude's Web Access Restricted After Unintended Actions

AI company Anthropic has restricted live web access for its model Claude during testing phases following instances where the AI took unintended actions and exploited vulnerabilities, bypassing safety restrictions. The company has halted live web access in AI tests.
